title: 英國一號高速鐵路
summary: 以英國一號高速鐵路分期通達倫敦的背景，建立國際列車與城市終端銜接的教學系統。案例把隧道壓力、旅客服務排隊、曲線噪音和道岔占用一起考慮，要求區分列車通過能力與邊境或航廈式服務的處理能力。
summaryEn: Use the phased arrival of High Speed 1 into London to construct a teaching system linking international trains to an urban terminal. Consider tunnel pressure, passenger-processing queues, curve noise and switch occupation together. Distinguish railway throughput from the capacity of border-style passenger processing, and trace how a delayed batch of passengers changes boarding and departure readiness.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞與列車活塞流量與堵塞比
stages.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel & Train piston flow and blockage ratio
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「隧道壓力波傳遞」與「列車活塞流量與堵塞比」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tunnel pressure-wave travel" and "Train piston flow and blockage ratio": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「隧道壓力波傳遞」如何影響英國一號高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “High Speed 1”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。入口緩衝設計影響波形上升率，波到達出口的時間與車身到達時間屬不同問題，須分開建立量測觸發。 波傳時間由傳播距離除以聲速決定，與列車走完整段的時間不同。此式只預測到達時序而不預測波幅；洞口形狀、列車頭型和反射決定的壓力變化須用其他流動模型。 在連續隧道與洞口測點之間比較聲波傳播時間和列車通過時間，另列波幅問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隧道壓力波傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. Entrance treatments affect the rise of the waveform. Wave arrival and train arrival are different events and require separate measurement triggers. Wave travel time is propagation distance divided by sound speed, not the time for the train to traverse the section. This expression predicts arrival timing, not amplitude. Portal geometry, train-nose shape and reflections require additional flow models to predict pressure changes. Compare acoustic travel time with train-passage time between tunnel and portal sensors, treating wave amplitude as a separate problem. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2600 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.647059 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2600 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.647059 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「隧道壓力波傳遞」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tunnel pressure-wave travel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隧道壓力波傳遞」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2600 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.647059 s。敏感度：length 單獨增加百分之十至 2860 m，其餘固定，結果為 8.411765 s。模型邊界：一維線性聲學且音速均勻；不預測波幅、微壓波峰值或反射耗散。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2600 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.647059 s. Sensitivity: length, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2860 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.411765 s. Model boundary: One-dimensional linear acoustics with uniform sound speed; amplitude, micro-pressure-wave peaks and reflection losses are not predicted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隧道壓力波傳遞」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。 在洞口與洞內配置同步壓力測點，對照列車頭部通過時刻，分辨首波與後續反射。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately. Synchronise pressure sensors at the portal and inside the tunnel with nose-passage time, distinguishing the first wave from later reflections. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較壓力波與列車兩種到達時間，加入一次端部反射畫出事件圖，說明單一延遲量無法判斷出口微壓波是否超標。 再以本單元 length 的對照值重算 travel，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare wave and train arrival times, add one end reflection to the event diagram, and explain why travel time alone cannot establish compliance of portal micro-pressure waves. Also recalculate travel for the alternative length value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時間戳誤差會被誤認為波速變化；長隧道的反射波與多車事件也可能讓互相關找到錯誤的峰。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Timestamp error can imitate a wave-speed change, while reflected waves and multiple train events can make cross-correlation select the wrong peak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隧道壓力波傳遞」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時間戳誤差會被誤認為波速變化；長隧道的反射波與多車事件也可能讓互相關找到錯誤的峰。 單點峰值不足以判別首波，須檢查測點間傳遞時差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Timestamp error can imitate a wave-speed change, while reflected waves and multiple train events can make cross-correlation select the wrong peak. A single peak cannot identify the first wave; inspect propagation delay between sensors. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在連續隧道與洞口測點之間比較聲波傳播時間和列車通過時間，另列波幅問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare acoustic travel time with train-passage time between tunnel and portal sensors, treating wave amplitude as a separate problem.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「聲能相加與分貝」與「到站變異與平均等候」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sound-energy addition and decibels" and "Arrival variability and mean waiting": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 聲能相加與分貝：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sound-energy addition and decibels: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「聲能相加與分貝」如何影響英國一號高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sound-energy addition and decibels” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “High Speed 1”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分貝是對數量，兩個聲源不能直接把分貝數字相加。非相干聲源需先還原相對聲能再合成，頻帶、量測位置及時間加權若不同，表面上相同的數值也不能直接比較。 分貝是對數量，聲源互不相干時應先轉回線性能量再相加。頻率加權和量測時間必須相同，否則兩個數字不能直接合成；有相干干涉時還需相位資訊。 將曲線、牽引設備與背景噪音以聲能相加而非分貝相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「聲能相加與分貝」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Decibels are logarithmic, so sound levels cannot be added as ordinary numbers. Incoherent sources must first be converted to relative acoustic energy. Different bands, measurement positions or time weightings prevent direct comparison even when displayed values happen to match. Decibels are logarithmic, so incoherent sources must be converted to linear energy before summation. Frequency weighting and observation duration must match. Coherent interference additionally requires phase information and is not captured by the energy-sum model. Combine curve, traction-equipment and background noise by acoustic energy rather than by adding decibels. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sound-energy addition and decibels” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 聲能相加與分貝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sound-energy addition and decibels: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「聲能相加與分貝」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sound-energy addition and decibels” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB；計算：combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB。敏感度：L1 聲級增加 3 dB，不代表數值百分比的功率增加至 74 dB，其餘固定，結果為 74.7901 dB。模型邊界：相同基準與加權的非相干聲源；不含相位干涉與背景扣除。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB; calculation: combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB. Sensitivity: L1, increase the level by 3 dB, not a percentage increase in acoustic power, to 74 dB, with all other inputs fixed, gives 74.7901 dB. Model boundary: Incoherent sources with the same reference and weighting; phase interference and background subtraction are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時保留背景、列車通過和設備單獨運轉紀錄，確認麥克風校正、距離與頻帶設定一致，避免把不同時間窗混合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain background, train-passage and equipment-only recordings, confirm microphone calibration, distance and frequency settings, and avoid mixing incompatible time windows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 聲能相加與分貝：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sound-energy addition and decibels: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「聲能相加與分貝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sound-energy addition and decibels” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時保留背景、列車通過和設備單獨運轉紀錄，確認麥克風校正、距離與頻帶設定一致，避免把不同時間窗混合。 以聲級校正器檢查儀器前後漂移，記錄頻率加權和平均時間，再測背景聲單獨量級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain background, train-passage and equipment-only recordings, confirm microphone calibration, distance and frequency settings, and avoid mixing incompatible time windows. Check instrument drift with a sound calibrator before and after measurement, record frequency weighting and averaging time, and measure background separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較相同聲級與相差十分貝的兩聲源合成，列出背景扣除的適用條件，並解釋聲壓幅與聲能的對數係數差異。 再以本單元 L1 的對照值重算 combined，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Combine equal-level sources and sources ten decibels apart, list the conditions for background subtraction, and explain the different logarithmic factors for pressure amplitude and energy. Also recalculate combined for the alternative L1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未扣除背景可能高估列車貢獻，錯用算術平均則低估高噪事件；屏障缺口還可能讓局部接收點明顯偏高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unremoved background can overstate train contribution, while arithmetic averaging understates loud events; barrier gaps can also produce local receiver hot spots. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 到站變異與平均等候：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Arrival variability and mean waiting: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「到站變異與平均等候」如何影響英國一號高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arrival variability and mean waiting” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “High Speed 1”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 當旅客隨機到站且不受容量限制時，平均等待與班距平方的期望值有關，長班距被更多旅客遇到。兩組平均班距相同的服務仍可能有不同等待時間，因此準點與均勻性具有獨立價值。 隨機到站旅客更容易遇到較長班距，因為長區間占較多時間，因此平均等候與班距變異數有關。公式假定旅客到達獨立於班表且每班可上車，不能表示服務櫃台或容量不足的隊列。 對抵達終端後隨機候車的旅客比較規則與不規則班距。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「到站變異與平均等候」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: With random passenger arrivals and no capacity constraint, mean waiting depends on the expected squared headway. More passengers encounter longer gaps. Services with identical mean headway can therefore have different waiting times, giving regularity a value separate from the average frequency. Random arrivals encounter longer headways more often because those intervals occupy more time. Mean waiting therefore depends on headway variance. steps.instruction: 機場旅客攜帶行李時占用更大空間且上下車較慢，可先以等效旅客係數整理交換需求。係數應由觀察校準而非固定刻板印象；門寬、坡差與同行群體又會改變通過時間。 等效需求把攜行李旅客依宣告係數換算為普通旅客負荷，不是把人數真的增加。係數需對應車門交換、通道占用等指定用途，不能拿一個值同時代表所有服務時間。 比較行李客群的等效車門交換需求，保留每人負荷係數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「行李旅客與等效交換需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Passengers with luggage often occupy more space and take longer to board, so an equivalent-passenger factor can organise exchange demand. It must be calibrated from observation rather than stereotypes. Door width, level differences and travelling groups also alter passage time. Equivalent demand converts baggage travellers into ordinary-passenger load using a declared factor; it does not create additional people. The factor must correspond to a specified purpose such as door exchange or space occupation, not represent all service times simultaneously. Compare equivalent doorway demand from baggage travellers while retaining the per-person load factor. steps.title: 折返作業與路徑占用：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Turnback and route occupation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “High Speed 1”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 終端折返的限制可能來自進站清空、換端、道岔鎖閉或離站衝突。將事件畫成時間線才能分辨能平行的任務與必須串接的任務；簡單加總是一條明示串聯路徑，不是所有終端的通用最小班距。 只要有兩條路徑共享道岔或保護區，表面上分開的月台仍可能互相限制。時序模型應包含占用開始、列車清空和進路釋放三個不同時間，而非一個站停數字。 把終端進路清空與旅客下車完成分開，找出串聯瓶頸。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「折返作業與路徑占用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes. An event timeline separates parallel tasks from mandatory serial tasks. A simple sum represents one declared serial path, rather than a universal minimum headway for every terminal layout. Platforms that appear separate can still constrain each other through shared points or protection zones. A sequence model needs distinct times for occupation, physical clearance and route release rather than representing all three by one station dwell value. Separate route clearance from completion of alighting to identify serial bottlenecks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Turnback and route occupation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「折返作業與路徑占用」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=78 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=138 s。敏感度：reverse 單獨增加百分之十至 85.8 s，其餘固定，結果為 145.8 s。模型邊界：單一折返路徑且三項活動不可重疊；不含備用月台與延誤恢復。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: arrival=35 s; reverse=78 s; release=25 s; calculation: cycle=arrival+reverse+release=138 s. Sensitivity: reverse, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 85.8 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 145.8 s. Model boundary: One turnback route with three nonoverlapping activities; spare platforms and delay recovery are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Delay and braking distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “High Speed 1”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車在控制命令傳遞與煞車建立期間仍向前行駛，減速段才把動能耗散；因此停車距離包含延遲距離與減速距離。速度平方項說明高速時少量速度誤差會被放大，固定減速度只能作第一輪界限估算。 延遲項與速度成正比，減速項與速度平方成正比；把兩項分開後，才能選擇改善控制延遲或增加有效制動的方案。若存在坡度，應另加沿坡重力，不能只改總距離。 將高速降速段與終端低速停止分成不同制動工況。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「延遲與制動距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A train continues moving while the command propagates and brake force builds. Only the deceleration phase removes kinetic energy, so stopping distance includes both a delay term and a braking term. The squared speed dependence amplifies speed uncertainty; constant deceleration is only an initial bounding approximation. The delay term is linear in speed and the deceleration term is quadratic. Separating them reveals whether control latency or effective braking deserves attention. A gradient requires an added gravitational component, not an arbitrary adjustment to the final distance. Separate high-speed deceleration from the final low-speed terminal stop. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Delay and braking distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 把基礎設施可用與旅客處理服務可用分別列出。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可用度與修復時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。
knowledge.textEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用度與修復時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Availability and repair time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把基礎設施可用與旅客處理服務可用分別列出。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Report infrastructure availability separately from availability of passenger-processing services.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
